verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an agent framework and its CLI and dev UI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents ADK telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The offline deployment option and token-usage tracking are adjacent features, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
